problem: The bare operators `+`, `-`, `*`, `/` — the allocating wrapper half of the add!/subtract!/multiply!/divide!/mul! family — carry NO docstring anywhere in the file (31 method definitions total, zero of them documented). fix: Add one thin docstring per operator symbol (`+`, `-`, `*`, `/`) on the bare binding, following the dot/cross pattern: one-sentence meaning + '@ref'-link to the defining `!` home (add!/subtract!/multiply!/divide!/mul!), no repeated formula.
